relations.subject: Alois Anton Führer
relations.evidence: Alois Anton Führer (26 November 1853 – 5 November 1930) was a German Indologist who worked for the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI)... he had to resign from his position in 1898.

relations.subject: Alois Anton Führer
relations.evidence: Führer re-converted to the Christian Catholic Church of Switzerland and worked as a priest from 1906 to 1930.
